q: Which collisions involved a vulnerable road user (pedestrian, cyclist or motorcyclist), and what types of vehicle were involved? Give the number of such collisions and the most common vehicle types with counts.
gold: SELECT ?vehicleType (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a :VRUCollision ; :hasVehicle ?v . ?v :vehicleType ?vehicleType } GROUP BY ?vehicleType ORDER BY DESC(?n)

q: Which five local authorities had the most serious or fatal collisions on A roads in wet or icy conditions, and how many did each have?
gold: SELECT ?la (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a :KSICollision ; :roadClass "A" ; :surfaceCondition ?s ; :occurredIn ?l . FILTER(?s IN ("Wet or damp","Frost or ice")) ?l :partOf ?a . ?a a :LocalAuthority ; :areaName ?la } GROUP BY ?la ORDER BY DESC(?n) ?la LIMIT 5

q: Which areas (LSOAs) are high-risk, meaning at least three serious or fatal collisions, and which police force covers each one? How many are there and which have the most?
gold: SELECT ?lsoa ?force (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?l a :HighRiskArea ; :areaCode ?lsoa ; :partOf+ ?pf . ?pf a :PoliceForce ; :areaName ?force . ?c a :KSICollision ; :occurredIn ?l } GROUP BY ?lsoa ?force ORDER BY DESC(?n) ?lsoa

q: When a pedestrian was killed or seriously hurt, what was the vehicle doing (manoeuvre), and was it dark or daylight? Summarise with counts.
gold: SELECT ?man (COUNT(DISTINCT ?k) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c :hasVehicle ?v . ?v :vehicleManoeuvre ?man ; :hasCasualty ?k . ?k a :Pedestrian ; :casualtySeverity ?s . FILTER(?s IN ("Fatal","Serious")) } GROUP BY ?man ORDER BY DESC(?n)

q: In each police force area, how many serious or fatal collisions happened in the dark and how many in daylight?
gold: SELECT ?force ?cond (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c a :KSICollision ; :lightCondition ?light ; :occurredIn ?l . ?l :partOf+ ?pf . ?pf a :PoliceForce ; :areaName ?force . BIND(IF(STRSTARTS(?light,"Dark"),"dark","daylight") AS ?cond) } GROUP BY ?force ?cond

q: How many serious or fatal collisions happened in the Gwent police area, and how many of them involved a vulnerable road user?
gold: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?ksi) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?vru) AS ?withVRU) WHERE { ?c a :KSICollision ; :occurredIn/:partOf+ ?pf . ?pf a :PoliceForce ; :areaName "Gwent" . OPTIONAL { ?c a :VRUCollision . BIND(?c AS ?vru) } }

q: Which children (age 0-15) were killed or seriously hurt, and were they pedestrians, passengers or drivers? Give counts by casualty class.
gold: SELECT ?cls (COUNT(DISTINCT ?k) AS ?n) WHERE { ?k a :ChildCasualty ; :casualtySeverity ?s ; :casualtyClass ?cls . FILTER(?s IN ("Fatal","Serious")) } GROUP BY ?cls ORDER BY DESC(?n)

q: Which collisions on fast roads (speed limit 50 mph or more) left a motorcyclist killed or seriously hurt? How many collisions, and the speed limit of the fastest ones?
gold: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?c :speedLimit ?sp ; :involvesCasualty ?x . ?x a :Motorcyclist ; :casualtySeverity ?sev . FILTER(?sp >= 50 && ?sev IN ("Fatal","Serious")) }

q: For collision 202560C002220, what are its vehicles, casualties, severity, road and weather conditions and administrative areas (LSOA, local authority, police force)?
In each high-risk area (LSOA with at least 3 serious or fatal collisions), how many serious or fatal collisions involved a vulnerable road user? Which areas have the most?
gold: SELECT ?lsoa (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?n) WHERE { ?l a :HighRiskArea ; :areaCode ?lsoa . ?c a :KSICollision , :VRUCollision ; :occurredIn ?l } GROUP BY ?lsoa ORDER BY DESC(?n) ?lsoa
